sources.finding: Current documentation points to Data Dragon 16.20.1 and supports zh_CN. No Augment entry or documented ARAM: Mayhem augment endpoint found. Mode-specific documented example is League Classic champion data, not Mayhem augments. Documentation warns Data Dragon can lag patches and region versions differ.
Documented tft-augments.json contains TFT augments. Excluded: wrong game mode.

Official Traditional-Chinese patch notes have a separate ARAM: Mayhem section with changed augment names. Not a complete catalog, no stable numeric IDs, and localization is zh_TW rather than mainland zh_CN. Cannot automatically convert spellings and presume exact OCR labels.

Official general policies identify Data Dragon as an asset source and specify disclaimer, registration/audit and supported-service expectations. This is conditional ecosystem guidance, not a verified unrestricted catalog license. No agreement accepted.

alternativeOfficialCatalogAudit.notVerified: Targeted official lol.qq.com searches returned no suitable catalog. This does not prove none exists. Third-party search hits were not adopted as official or licensed source evidence.
